description: This file implements the accept task for an advanced socket object within the ANSC framework. It manages incoming connection requests, creates new socket objects for each connection, and notifies the owner via a sink interface.

classes.name: ANSC_STATUS
classes.description: Status codes indicating success, failure, or request to repeat the operation.

classes.name: PANSC_XSOCKET_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to an instance of the Xsocket object, representing a socket connection.

classes.name: PANSC_XSINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to a sink interface object used to notify the owner of socket events.

classes.name: xskt_fd_set
classes.description: File descriptor set structure for select() system call.

classes.name: xskt_timeval
classes.description: Time value structure for polling intervals in select().

classes.name: xskt_socket_addr_in
classes.description: Structure representing IPv4 socket address, including family, address, and port.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscXsocketAcceptTask(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Main function handling incoming socket connections, creating new socket objects, and notifying the owner via sink.
